text: Architecture decision: integrate in gated slices. S0 aligns the common locus4s source dependency; S1 puts mesh4s-core behind the existing TriangleMesh and MeshTopology facade. Only then add shared SurfaceRealization owners, locus4s-backed surface data, cached renderer renditions, and graph/numerical cleanup. Scala.js GIFTI ingestion remains an already-complete independent capability. ScalaFIM retains hemisphere, surface kind, surfaceToWorld and RAS+, sampling, atlas, workflow, picking, and renderer policy; mesh4s owns lawful topology and basic geometry.
